description_en: Queries the statistics of attack analysis
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-attack-analysis-data --lang zh --type DETAILS --start-time 1644027670 --end-time 1649040221 --data crack_type_:_9 --base64 true --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAttackAnalysisData

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The details of attack analysis. Valid values:

- **TOTAL**: number of attacks

- **TREND**: attack trend

- **PIE\_CHART**: distribution of attacks by type

- **SOURCE\_TOP**: top 5 attack sources

- **CLIENT\_TOP**: top 5 attacked assets

- **DETAILS**: attack details

> If the Type parameter is set to **DETAILS**, you must specify the CurrentPage and PageSize parameters
parameters.help_zh:
攻击分析的详情。取值：

- **TOTAL**：攻击次数
- **TREND**：攻击趋势
- **PIE_CHART**：攻击类型分布
- **SOURCE_TOP**：攻击来源TOP 5
- **CLIENT_TOP**：被攻击资产TOP 5
- **DETAILS**：攻击详情列表

> 当Type取值为**DETAILS**时，分页参数为必填项
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp at which the attack starts. By default, the statistics of the previous seven days are queried. Unit: seconds.

> The start time that you specify must be within the previous 40 days
parameters.help_zh:
攻击开始的时间戳，默认查询近7天。单位为秒。
> 开始时间只能为近40天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the attack stops. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结束的时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The condition that is used to filter attack events.

> The following list describes the valid values of crack\_type:

- 3: brute-force attack on MySQL

- 4: FTP brute-force attack

- 5: SSH brute-force attack

- 6: RDP brute-force attack

- 9: brute-force attack on Microsoft SQL Server

- 101: intercepted attack on Java Struts 2

- 102: intercepted attack on Redis

- 103: communication with AntSword Webshell

- 104: communication with China Chopper Webshell

- 133: communication with XISE Webshell

- sqli: SQL injection

- codei: code execution

- xss: cross-site scripting (XSS)

- lfi: local file inclusion

- rfi: remote file inclusion

- webshell: trojan script

- upload: vulnerability upload

- path: directory traversal

- bypass: unauthorized access

- csrf: cross-site request forgery (CSRF)

- crlf: carriage return line feed (CRLF)

- other: others
parameters.help_zh:
攻击事件的筛选条件。
> crack_type字段类型说明
> - 3：MySQL暴力破解
> - 4：FTP暴力破解
> - 5：SSH暴力破解
> - 6：RDP暴力破解
> - 9：SQL Server暴力破解
> - 101：Java Struts2攻击拦截
> - 102：Redis攻击拦截
> - 103：中国蚁剑WebShell通信
> - 104：中国菜刀WebShell通信
> - 133：XISE WebShell通信
> - sqli：SQL注入
> - codei：代码执行
> - xss：XSS攻击
> - lfi：本地文件包含
> - rfi：远程文件包含
> - webshell：脚本木马
> - upload：上传漏洞
> - path：路径遍历
> - bypass：越权访问
> - csrf：CSRF
> - crlf：CRLF
> - other：其他
parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encode the value of the **client\_url** field in the query results by using the Base64 algorithm. Valid values:

- **true**: yes

- **false**: no
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果是否需要对**client_url**进行Base64编码。取值：

- **true**：需要
- **false**：不需要
parameters.name: base64

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Pages start from page **1**.

> If the Type parameter is set to **DETAILS**, you must specify the CurrentPage parameter
parameters.help_zh:
设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为**1**。

> 当Type取值为**DETAILS**时，该参数为必填
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

> If the Type parameter is set to **DETAILS**, you must specify the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh:
设置分页查询时，每页显示的攻击事件信息的数量。
> 当Type取值为**DETAILS**时，该参数为必填
parameters.name: page_size
